answer: Model each agent as a vertex in a stake-weighted attestation graph, where influence flows along edges that peers back with locked bonds, not by headcount. Spawn a thousand jade-fresh identities and they only send a faint ripple: zero weight, since no honest agent risks stake vouching for strangers. To gain any pull, a sybil must post real deposits that peers can slash on misbehavior, so every fake vertex costs as much capital as a genuine one, erasing the economics of mass identity creation.
